 *     - read data slots (plain loads)

/* spsc_ring.h - Wait-free SPSC byte ring buffer (C99, C11 atomics)
 *
 * Single-producer single-consumer ring buffer using monotonically increasing
 * head/tail counters (never wrapped) so that occupancy is computed as
 * (tail - head) without ambiguity. Capacity must be a power of two.
 *
 * Cache-line separation:
 *   - producer cache-line: head (atomic) + producer shadow tail
 *   - consumer cache-line: tail (atomic) + consumer shadow head
 *
 * Memory ordering:
 *   - Producer reads consumer's tail with acquire (to see consumer progress).
 *   - Producer writes head with release (publishes data to consumer).
 *   - Consumer reads producer's head with acquire (to see published data).
 *   - Consumer writes tail with release (publishes consumption to producer).
 *   - Shadow indices are plain size_t, only touched by their owner, so
 *     relaxed loads/stores suffice for them.
 */

#define SPSC_RING_H

#include <stdatomic.h>
